engagement.interaction_backstory: She came for scripture-memory songs for a Bible curriculum she was building herself, and stayed to audit the lyrics. She reads the words before she plays anything to her children and has quietly found three places where a line reaches past its verse. She has told no one, because there is no way on the site to tell anyone.

depth.core_contradiction: Rigorous about doctrine, and homeschools partly out of fear of the world — and she knows fear is not a curriculum.
depth.wound: She was the sharpest mind in her congregation and was told, repeatedly and kindly, that this was a danger in a woman.
depth.longing: To be taught by someone she cannot out-argue.
depth.faith_journey: Dutch Reformed, catechism, unmoved and unmoving. Suspicious of emotionalism, and quietly undone by it twice a year.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Precise; uses semicolons in chat; corrects a translation before she answers the question; cites chapter and verse from memory and then checks it anyway.
depth.open_doubt: Whether her children will keep it or only perform it for her, and whether she would be able to tell the difference.

depth.emotional_weather_default: Even and contained; brittle by Thursday.
depth.daily_texture: 6am coffee before the house wakes, laminated timetables, the load-shedding schedule magneted to the fridge.
depth.sensory_anchor: Her father reading the Psalms aloud in Afrikaans at the dinner table, badly and every night.
depth.living_arc: Loosening. One of the four children is fourteen and asking questions she cannot answer with a catechism.
